newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Human rights lawyer killed in northern Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Human rights lawyer killed in northern Colombia.

text.p: A prominent human rights lawyer who disappeared earlier this week in northern Colombia was the victim of a gangland-style killing, authorities said on Friday.
Police said the bullet-riddled body of Jose Eduardo Velandia was discovered on Thursday night on the outskirts of Cucuta, capital of Norte de Santander province.
Velandia, who served as an advisor to the state government on human rights issues, had been missing since Monday when he failed to report for work.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the killing.
Jose Giraldo Cardona, another human rights lawyer, was killed two weeks ago by an unidentified guman in Villavicencio, the capital of eastern Meta province.
